sections.headline: Modern Life May Be Working Against Your Body's Natural Balance
sections.body: Today's lifestyle — processed foods, chronic stress, and environmental toxins — can place quiet pressure on the body's natural kidney and urinary rhythm. Many people aren't getting enough beneficial plant compounds from diet alone, which may make it harder to feel light, energized, and comfortable. When internal balance is off, it can show up as puffiness, fatigue, or disrupted nights.
bullets: Dietary gaps may limit kidney filtration support
Stress and toxins can burden the urinary system
Hormonal imbalance may contribute to low energy and hair changes

sections.headline: Nature's Bladder Guardian — Backed by Centuries of Traditional Use
sections.body: Pumpkin seed oil has been used for generations to support urinary health and hormonal balance. Its naturally occurring beta-sitosterol and zinc have been studied for their ability to help support healthy urinary flow and comfort. Together, these compounds work to help the body feel calmer, clearer, and more resilient — without harsh or synthetic ingredients.
bullets: Beta-sitosterol helps support healthy urinary comfort
Zinc promotes hair follicle strength and cellular resilience
Omega 3-6-9 fatty acids support a healthy inflammatory response

faqs.question: Where can I buy Lumora Pumpkin Seed Oil?
faqs.answer: Lumora Pumpkin Seed Oil Softgels are available exclusively through our official website. This allows us to ensure the highest quality, freshness, and best pricing for every customer.

faqs.question: What ingredients are in Lumora?
faqs.answer: Each softgel contains cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil (Cucurbita pepo) with saw palmetto extract. That's it — no fillers, artificial additives, or preservatives.

faqs.question: Is Lumora safe to take with my current medications?
faqs.answer: Lumora Pumpkin Seed Oil is generally considered safe for daily use, but it's always best to consult your healthcare provider before starting any new supplement — especially if you take medications or have existing health conditions.

faqs.question: How soon might I notice a difference?
faqs.answer: Many customers report noticing calmer urinary function, steadier energy, and improved comfort within the first few days or weeks. Consistent daily use provides the best long-term support for your kidneys, bladder, and overall vitality.

faqs.question: How many softgels should I take each day?
faqs.answer: Take 2 softgels daily with food, or as directed by your healthcare provider. For additional support, you may take up to 3 softgels per day. Consistency is key — daily use delivers the best results over time.

faqs.question: What if Lumora doesn't work for me?
faqs.answer: If you're not satisfied for any reason, simply contact us within 30 days of receiving your order. Our team will be happy to help with a return, replacement, or full refund — your satisfaction is our top priority.
